What we do

The Work

No flash-wall shortcuts. Every piece starts with your idea — then we draw it, size it, and place it for the body it lives on.

01

Custom Tattoos

One-of-one designs built from your reference, story, or rough sketch. If you can describe it, we can draw it.

 → 02

Photorealism

Portraits and lifelike detail with soft shading and depth — the kind of work that reads from across the room and up close.

 → 03

Traditional

Bold lines, solid color, timeless subjects. American traditional done the way it was meant to be done.

 → 04

Black & Grey

Smooth gradients, deep blacks, and clean contrast. Our signature — from fine-line pieces to full dark work.

 → 05

Skull Tattoos

Skulls, dark imagery, and sinister subjects with texture, shadow, and weight. This is home turf.

 → 06

Memorial Tattoos

Portraits, names, dates, and tributes handled with care. A permanent piece for the people who matter most.

The studio

Dark room.
Clean work.

On East Mill Plain in Vancouver, Sinister is built for people who want more than a quick tattoo — they want the right tattoo. Anime and pop-culture pieces, dark black & grey, photoreal portraits, memorial work: the portfolio is wide because the clients bring real ideas in the door.

Come in with a screenshot, a photo, a name, or just a feeling you want to carry. The consultation is free, and it’s where the piece actually gets made — placement, scale, line weight, and how it will age on your skin.
